findings: CLI correctly enforces fail-closed rejection for path traversal, symlinks, and oversized inputs.
Authority boundaries are strictly maintained: no self-authorization, no self-approval, no public write actions.
Adversarial rejection policy covers a comprehensive set of attack classes with stable reason codes.
Timezone-aware datetime parsing is enforced, preventing naive timestamp injection.
Task eligibility checks correctly intersect roles, capabilities, and file scopes.
Lease granting requires an external issuer and validates authority action scope.
Recommendation calibration explicitly disclaims decision authority and adoption mapping.
Current state accurately reflects pilot status without claiming public launch or certification.
Community manifest correctly lists non-capabilities including merge, release, and certify.
Agent index clearly separates evidence from truth and verification from authorization.
